# Vendored source

Repository: https://github.com/w1ne/iolinki-master

Revision: `55517bbee8849725d80c06c894d54095de5c64f1`

The source, headers, protocol tests, changelog and implementation-status document
match this revision. Its READ requests omit on-request data and its response
